GameplayEvent Rules4 sections
Special Notes

◆ During this event, you can obtain the featured Fellow Dionysia and advance her rarity to UR★.

◆ Once you obtain Dionysia, the Resonance effect feature will unlock, which allows players to "resonate" with chosen Fellows, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Dionysia to UR★ will additionally unlock the Resonance skill feature.

◆ After you upgrade Dionysia to the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will also unlock. Increase the Trust Level of UR★ Dionysia as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will expire or convert into other items after the event ends, while the task and gacha progress will reset.

Minigame

◆ During the event, you can play the Orchard Harvesting minigame. Swap tiles to clear fruits, complete the orders, and earn points.

◆ Stamina for the minigame regenerates automatically over time or can be quickly restored with items.

◆ Accumulate points to reach certain score milestones and claim the corresponding rewards from the achievements.

Event Pass

◆ Consuming stamina in the minigame increases your Pass Points. Reach the required number of Pass Points to get Pass rewards.

◆ After purchasing the pass, you will unlock premium rewards including gacha tickets.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Dionysia's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you finish in the top 3 and have increased Dionysia's Aptitude to 10000, you will receive an exclusive permanent title.

CompetitionRankings1 ranking type

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

P
Personal Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Dionysia's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you finish in the top 3 and have increased Dionysia's Aptitude to 10000, you will receive an exclusive permanent title.

GameplayEvent Rules6 sections
Special Notice

◆ During this event, you can obtain the featured Fellow Fafnyria and advance her rarity to UR★.

◆ Once you obtain Fafnyria, the Resonance effect feature will unlock, which allows players to "resonate" with chosen Fellows, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Fafnyria to UR★ will additionally unlock the Resonance skill feature.

◆ After you upgrade Fafnyria to the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will also unlock. Increase the Trust Level of UR★ Fafnyria as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will expire or convert into other items after the event ends, while the task and gacha progress will reset.

Minigame

◆ During the event, you can play the minigame Fafnyria's Garden, in which you can earn Flower Coins by cultivating and selling flowers.

◆ Use your Flower Coins in the shop to redeem various rewards, including Love Gacha Tickets.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fafnyria's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If specific conditions are met, you will receive a permanent title.

True Love Ceremony

◆ Once the ceremony begins, you can start making vows to your desired Fellows.

◆ Making a vow to a Fellow will activate their Family identity (their Fellow identity will remain). Simultaneously, you will obtain the Fellow's exclusive costume.

◆ Purchase [Vow Bundles] to obtain True Love Keys, which allow you to form vows.

◆ After the event ends, [Vow Bundles] can no longer be purchased, but [True Love Keys] will remain and can still be used to make vows to your Fellows in the Fellow page.

True Love Key (Silver) Bundle

◆ The True Love Key (Silver) Bundle can be claimed for free only once for life.

◆ The free bundle will not be sent to your mail if you do not claim it before the current event period ends. But it can still be claimed for free when the event opens next time.

◆ If the free bundle has been claimed, it will revert to its original price in subsequent rerun events.

Reward Period

◆ There will be a 24-hour claim period for rewards after the event ends.

◆ Please redeem your rewards in the exchange shop during this period; once it ends, the shop will close, and Event Coins will expire.

GameplayEvent Rules6 sections
Special Notice

◆ During this event, you can obtain the featured Fellow Fafnyria and advance her rarity to UR★.

◆ Once you obtain Fafnyria, the Resonance effect feature will unlock, which allows players to "resonate" with chosen Fellows, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Fafnyria to UR★ will additionally unlock the Resonance skill feature.

◆ After you upgrade Fafnyria to the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will also unlock. Increase the Trust Level of UR★ Fafnyria as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will expire or convert into other items after the event ends, while the task and gacha progress will reset.

Minigame

◆ During the event, you can play the minigame Fafnyria's Garden, in which you can earn Flower Coins by cultivating and selling flowers.

◆ Use your Flower Coins in the shop to redeem various rewards, including Love Gacha Tickets.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fafnyria's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If specific conditions are met, you will receive a permanent title.

True Love Ceremony

◆ Once the ceremony begins, you can start making vows to your desired Fellows.

◆ Making a vow to a Fellow will activate their Family identity (their Fellow identity will remain). Simultaneously, you will obtain the Fellow's exclusive costume.

◆ Purchase [Vow Bundles] to obtain True Love Keys, which allow you to form vows.

◆ After the event ends, [Vow Bundles] can no longer be purchased, but [True Love Keys] will remain and can still be used to make vows to your Fellows in the Fellow page.

True Love Key (Silver) Bundle

◆ The True Love Key (Silver) Bundle can be claimed for free only once for life.

◆ The free bundle will not be sent to your mail if you do not claim it before the current event period ends. But it can still be claimed for free when the event opens next time.

◆ If the free bundle has been claimed, it will revert to its original price in subsequent rerun events.

Reward Period

◆ There will be a 24-hour claim period for rewards after the event ends.

◆ Please redeem your rewards in the exchange shop during this period; once it ends, the shop will close, and Event Coins will expire.

Core Rewards

GameplayEvent Rules6 sections
Special Notice

◆ During this event, you can obtain the featured Fellow Fafnyria and advance her rarity to UR★.

◆ Once you obtain Fafnyria, the Resonance effect feature will unlock, which allows players to "resonate" with chosen Fellows, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Fafnyria to UR★ will additionally unlock the Resonance skill feature.

◆ After you upgrade Fafnyria to the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will also unlock. Increase the Trust Level of UR★ Fafnyria as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will expire or convert into other items after the event ends, while the task and gacha progress will reset.

Minigame

◆ During the event, you can play the minigame Fafnyria's Garden, in which you can earn Flower Coins by cultivating and selling flowers.

◆ Use your Flower Coins in the shop to redeem various rewards, including Love Gacha Tickets.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fafnyria's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If specific conditions are met, you will receive a permanent title.

True Love Ceremony

◆ Once the ceremony begins, you can start making vows to your desired Fellows.

◆ Making a vow to a Fellow will activate their Family identity (their Fellow identity will remain). Simultaneously, you will obtain the Fellow's exclusive costume.

◆ Purchase [Vow Bundles] to obtain True Love Keys, which allow you to form vows.

◆ After the event ends, [Vow Bundles] can no longer be purchased, but [True Love Keys] will remain and can still be used to make vows to your Fellows in the Fellow page.

True Love Key (Silver) Bundle

◆ The True Love Key (Silver) Bundle can be claimed for free only once for life.

◆ The free bundle will not be sent to your mail if you do not claim it before the current event period ends. But it can still be claimed for free when the event opens next time.

◆ If the free bundle has been claimed, it will revert to its original price in subsequent rerun events.

Reward Period

◆ There will be a 24-hour claim period for rewards after the event ends.

◆ Please redeem your rewards in the exchange shop during this period; once it ends, the shop will close, and Event Coins will expire.

◆ Purchase [Vow Bundles] to obtain True Love Keys, which allow you to form vows.

◆ After the event ends, [Vow Bundles] can no longer be purchased, but [True Love Keys] will remain and can still be used to make vows to your Fellows in the Fellow page.

True Love Key (Silver) Bundle

◆ The True Love Key (Silver) Bundle can be claimed for free only once for life.

◆ The free bundle will not be sent to your mail if you do not claim it before the current event period ends. But it can still be claimed for free when the event opens next time.

◆ If the free bundle has been claimed, it will revert to its original price in subsequent rerun events.

Reward Period

◆ There will be a 24-hour claim period for rewards after the event ends.

◆ Please redeem your rewards in the exchange shop during this period; once it ends, the shop will close, and Event Coins will expire.
